faqs.question: Can attendance data sync with payroll?
faqs.answer: Yes. Attendance data can be exported or integrated with HRMS and payroll software, including our own HRMS solution.

faqs.question: Fingerprint or face recognition: which is better?
faqs.answer: Face recognition is touchless and handles workers whose fingerprints wear out, while fingerprint devices are cost-effective for most offices. We'll suggest what suits your workforce.

faqs.question: Can one system handle multiple locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cloud-connected devices let you view attendance across branches from a single dashboard.
